title: ARE multi-cycle evolution runtime implementation plan

product_capability_support.interpretation: supporting policy and predecessor realization evidence; neither is a separate Product Capability or a new adoption decision

objective: Extend the existing ARE evolution-runtime with one JSON-controlled, reconstructible multi-cycle kernel and deliver benchmark-research/v1 first far enough to reconstruct and safely resume the GLM 8K ContextBench H-EN frontier under separate execution authorization.
implementation_authority: PL-04-A, PL-05-A, PL-06-A and the explicit working-prototype continuation consumed through P4; none for provider calls, benchmark execution, activation or P5 operational effects

route_binding.write_ceiling: planning candidates only; no implementation authority
route_binding.blocker: CyberAlchemy-v2 Goals validation is currently blocked; planning output cannot be registered as admitted execution state

p1_implementation_binding.scope: P1 protocol, schemas, validation, receipts, business ontology, DomainSpec source and deterministic projections only

p2_implementation_binding.scope: P2 durable commit chain, append-only event and receipt entries, content-addressed objects, three derived projection layers, disposable SQLite index, JSON stdin CLI, recovery and diagnosis only

p3_implementation_binding.scope: P3 native phase admission, ready-work derivation, bounded leases, explicit recovery, settlement, accounting, retry lineage and typed non-authorizing handoffs through the P2 durable kernel only

p4_implementation_binding.scope: P4 provider-free local prototype: exact H-EN R2/R7 legacy import, durable semantic reconstruction, ready independent-review frontier and reconstruction bundle index only

hen07_planning.payload_measurement: UTF-8 byte length of deterministic compact JSON including enclosing structure
hen07_planning.payload_ceiling_interpretation: provider-independent storage and transport bound; not a token estimate or HEN-09 admission
hen07_planning.aggregate_record_ceiling_interpretation: maximum candidates retained after deduplication; the 4096-byte ceiling remains independently controlling
hen07_planning.wire_representation: declared field-order tuples inside canonical JSON

baseline_evidence.interpretation: predecessor regression baseline only; not conformance to the candidate architecture

construction_lane.name: bind-product-carrier-and-baseline
construction_lane.outcome: Exact Project, Goal, Product Capability, definition, source, validator, and D65 construction identities are available.
construction_lane.completion_gate: The Goals blocker is repaired or carried as an explicit blocking result and no carrier identity is inferred by the plan.

construction_lane.name: freeze-json-protocol-and-cycle-definition-contracts
construction_lane.outcome: Closed versioned schemas and a non-enabling five-type definition registry.
key_outputs: DomainSpec source and deterministic compiled graph and system-ontology projection
artifact, envelope, admission, and handoff schemas
construction_lane.completion_gate: No public command can set state directly or transfer authority, and hostile schema tests pass.

construction_lane.name: durable-kernel-recovery-and-projections
construction_lane.outcome: One durable event authority reconstructs aggregate cycle, subordinate record, and executable work projections.
construction_lane.completion_gate: A fresh process reconstructs byte-identical authoritative state without trusting the operational index.

construction_lane.name: bounded-work-admission-settlement-and-handoffs
construction_lane.outcome: Ready work, leases, bounded effects, settlements, and handoffs are coordinated without agent-owned state.
key_outputs: native Research DAG and Work Plan coordination without a second executor
RWO-derived conformance cases without a runtime dependency
generic CR-02 envelope and admission mechanism
construction_lane.completion_gate: Every effectful work item has current phase admission and exactly one durable settlement.

construction_lane.name: benchmark-research-h-en-reconstruction
construction_lane.outcome: The current GLM 8K ContextBench H-EN candidate is reconstructed as awaiting-validation without rewriting history.
key_outputs: DG-05 dry-run and committed import manifests
construction_lane.completion_gate: Exact source hashes, chronology, exposure, accounting gaps, and missing evidence are preserved; E5 is only a legacy alias.

construction_lane.name: h-en-validation-and-benchmark-resumption
construction_lane.outcome: One exact next H-EN experiment is independently validated, frozen, preflighted, and eligible for a separate execution decision.
key_outputs: WSL, Docker, dataset, provider, credential-slot, disk, and resource preflight
construction_lane.completion_gate: Execution begins only after a user-approved immutable envelope and runtime launch admission; settlement preserves complete outputs and accounting.

construction_lane.name: remaining-cycle-adapters
construction_lane.outcome: Research learning, engine improvement, interaction learning, and controlled upgrade conform to the shared kernel without semantic merging.
construction_lane.completion_gate: Each adapter has separate DG-01 admission and passes kernel plus cycle-specific hostile and recovery suites.

construction_lane.name: space-first-archive-lifecycle
construction_lane.outcome: Terminal distant-cycle bytes move to verified compact storage while identity and reconstruction remain intact.
construction_lane.completion_gate: Archive restore reproduces original hashes and permanent evidence deletion remains user-gated.

construction_lane.name: freeze-and-assess-product-candidate
construction_lane.outcome: One immutable implementation candidate and collect-all conformance assessment exist for a separate acceptance decision.
construction_lane.completion_gate: Candidate assessment makes no adoption, installation, activation, release, deployment, or external-effect claim.

parallelization.reason: Resume the bounded H-EN benchmark vertical without waiting for unrelated cycle adapters or the full archive optimization.

operational_support.name: wsl-toolchain-and-docker-preflight
operational_support.evidence: exact versions and executable paths, repository Rust launcher doctor result, container smoke test

operational_support.name: benchmark-data-and-provider-readiness
operational_support.evidence: dataset digest, exact model settings, credential-slot presence without secret capture, bounded dry run

operational_support.name: storage-capacity-and-archive-destination
operational_support.evidence: capacity estimate, locality policy, restoration destination, failure behavior

operational_support.name: upgrade-process-and-credential-isolation
operational_support.evidence: separate process, least-privilege slot, denial proof from all other workers

open_questions.question: When should the frozen H-EN candidate receive credentialed Z.AI tokenizer-only qualification?
open_questions.blocking_scope: real 8K admission and every later live benchmark stage

deferred_phase_choices: P4 ContextBench adapter process boundary and exact import manifest
P5 provider, model, credential slot, and concrete H-EN effect limits
P7 archive codec, pack size, locality thresholds, and restore cadence
blocked_actions: register this plan as admitted execution state
infer or create a Goal or Product Capability without its route and owner decision
perform P5 qualification effects or any benchmark execution from this candidate alone
admit or enable a cycle definition from registry presence
call a provider or execute a benchmark
activate, publish, release, or deploy a variant
claim_ceiling: Working local prototype with focused passing P1 through P4 evidence. It does not admit the Goal or construction binding, independently approve H-EN, prove the complete runtime, or grant tokenizer qualification, benchmark execution, provider use, activation, publication, release, deployment, or external-effect authority.
